input: Figure out how to start saving for retirement

input: Get back into running after an injury

verdict.notes: SET B has several weaknesses: Q1 uses third-person ("the user") instead of second-person, making it feel robotic and impersonal; Q5 combines multiple options in a single question (race day, specific date, or just comfortable), slightly violating atomicity; Q7 lumps three unrelated items (gym, shoes, outdoor space) into one compound question. B also misses a critical unknown that A captures well — how long the person has been *unable* to run (i.e., the recovery duration so far), replacing it with a less useful question about equipment access.
